# apple_retention_message_version (Resource)

Creates a version of a retention message's content, which App Review reviews before people see it. Add text with `apple_retention_message_localization`, then submit the version with the `apple_submit_retention_message_version` action. A version can't be changed or deleted: every change creates a new version, and destroying the resource only removes it from the Terraform state. Deleting the retention message deletes its versions. To change approved content, create a new version. Import it by ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The image is optional. A retention message placement has no localization.
resource "apple_app_asset_library_placement" "stay" {
  image_id        = apple_app_asset_library_image.stay.id
  placement_type  = "RETENTION_MESSAGE_ASSET"
  placement_group = "DEFAULT_PROFILE"
}

resource "apple_retention_message_version" "first" {
  retention_message_id = apple_retention_message.stay.id
  placement_id         = apple_app_asset_library_placement.stay.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `retention_message_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the retention message, e.g. `apple_retention_message.example.id`.

### Optional

- `placement_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of a `RETENTION_MESSAGE_ASSET` placement whose image the message shows, e.g. `apple_app_asset_library_placement.example.id`. Unset means a text-only message.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the retention message version.
- `state` (String) Review state of the version, e.g. `PREPARE_FOR_SUBMISSION`, `WAITING_FOR_REVIEW` or `APPROVED`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = apple_retention_message_version.first
  identity = {
    id = "4820193376"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the retention message version.

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import apple_retention_message_version.first 4820193376
```
